title: ArcCivs local hall height and pre-work SITE Y retarget; BEFORE-source economy assessment

Handoff before a batch would overwrite the oldstock barrel, and by the finalbatch, must use existing pendingControls plus an exact27-slot relocation journal to a proven AIR receiver; retire the oldbarrel only after it is empty. Exact overlap/handoff sequencing is still being designed and is not claimed implemented.

An actual native control barrel still exists; its placement/retirement and allexisting contents must be conserved through the ordinary receipt. If the canonical newmarker needs one AIR cut, it must be a saved ordinary terrain cell, never immediate free digging. This is planned work, not completed native mutation. Current footprint has1085loaded columns, native min/median/max69/76/80 and anchor71; original ground is explicitly unproven. The proposed recipe, prices, per-action duration, production/research and AutoSupply policy are unchanged. CivsMaterials.required skips before==after, so moving identical authored geometry can still change its realized payable bill. Candidate targetY, actual cut/fill, material bill, work/batch totals, elapsed completion, supply quantities and long-run throughput areUNKNOWN until real capture and validation; no zero item/earthwork delta is encoded.

Five already-founded LAB villages compete inside the same at-most1receipt/s service, not five times that rate. Existing supply emission is nonzero; actual demand/materialmix/grant timing may change.

Direct new mint/burn stays separately0Vault,0premiumtokens,0physicalEMERALD and0playerXP under this proposed scope. Native goods/EMERALD use the existing physical journalled trade and unchanged rates/reserves; earlier completion can alter when or how much existing trade/production occurs. No treasury seed, clone, refund, payout or repeated bootstrap supplies is allowed.

Existing terrain application uses normal saved batches with an empty terrain item requirement map and no breakNaturally/drops/inventory transfer. World block creation/removal and changes in later manual extraction are not zero just because direct inventory payout is absent. Tools, food, production, resident skills and available progress can change indirectly; their numerical delta is not measured.

Current SELL/AutoSell, future SELL-to-contract replacement and SHADOW flows remain distinct and unchanged. No item-to-money conversion is invented. No new product price/progression/savings time is introduced; no live ledger/rate was queried in this worker's no-runtime scope. One owner-authorized wipe already occurred and allfive cities alreadyexist; this assessment authorizes or performs no further wipe.
